question: How does immersion in mine-ness toward objects create a new world?
premises: Knowable objects can be appropriated as mine
A new world can be fashioned
inference: From immersion in mine-ness toward the object of knowledge, one creates a new world.
uncertainties: The agent of nirmiṇoti is implied by context
plain_english: From immersion in mine-ness toward the object, one creates a new world.
